concept.title: Quay.io plan tiers
concept.shortdesc: Quay.io offers a free tier and paid plans with additional capacity and features. You can use this overview to compare hosted options when you evaluate Quay.io against a self-managed Red Hat Quay deployment.

conbody.p: In addition to a free tier, Quay.io offers several paid plans with enhanced benefits. Plan names, limits, and prices are listed on the Quay.io Pricing page.

Quay.io subscriptions are handled by the Stripe payment processing platform. A valid credit card is required to subscribe to a paid plan.
